subject: Euglycemic DKA (SGLT2 inhibitor-induced)
dx: near-normal glucose (<200) with high anion gap acidosis and ketosis; history of SGLT2i use

subject: Hypothyroidism (myxedema)
dx: elevated TSH, low free T4

subject: Hypercalcemia (e.g., primary hyperparathyroidism)
dx: Elevated serum calcium and PTH levels

subject: Idiopathic non-cirrhotic portal hypertension (INCPH) / hepatoportal sclerosis
dx: Liver biopsy showing absence of cirrhosis/fibrosis despite clinical portal hypertension; normal or near-normal liver function

subject: Alcoholic ketoacidosis
dx: history of alcohol binge with poor intake, glucose normal/low, absent or minimal hyperglycemia

subject: SIADH from occult malignancy (e.g., small cell lung cancer)
dx: chest imaging, persistent SIADH despite fluid restriction

subject: Budd-Chiari syndrome (hepatic vein outflow obstruction)
dx: Doppler/CT/MRI showing hepatic vein or IVC thrombosis/stenosis, caudate lobe hypertrophy

subject: Systemic lupus erythematosus
dx: ANA, anti-dsDNA positive; other cytopenias, clinical SLE features

subject: Starvation ketosis
dx: milder acidosis (pH usually >7.3), glucose normal/low, history of prolonged fasting

subject: Cerebral salt wasting
dx: volume status (hypovolemic vs euvolemic), response to saline vs fluid restriction

subject: Antiphospholipid syndrome
dx: lupus anticoagulant, anticardiolipin, anti-beta2-glycoprotein antibodies positive; thrombosis history

subject: Salicylate or toxic alcohol ingestion
dx: elevated osmolar gap, disproportionate anion gap acidosis, absent/mild ketosis, toxicology screen

subject: IgG4-related disease
dx: elevated serum IgG4, tissue IgG4+ plasma cell infiltrate, storiform fibrosis on biopsy

subject: Gout (crystal arthropathy)
dx: synovial fluid negatively birefringent monosodium urate crystals; culture negative

subject: Myelodysplastic syndrome
dx: bone marrow biopsy shows dysplasia, cytogenetic abnormalities

subject: Pulmonary embolism with infarction
dx: CT pulmonary angiogram, D-dimer, absence of true infiltrate progression, pleuritic pain out of proportion

subject: ANCA-associated vasculitis (granulomatosis with polyangiitis)
dx: positive PR3/c-ANCA, sinonasal or renal involvement, biopsy showing necrotizing granulomatous vasculitis without giant cells typical of GCA

subject: Pseudogout (CPPD/calcium pyrophosphate deposition disease)
dx: positively birefringent rhomboid crystals on synovial fluid analysis, chondrocalcinosis on imaging

subject: HIV infection
dx: HIV serology/PCR positive

subject: Cryptogenic organizing pneumonia (COP/BOOP)
dx: failure to improve on antibiotics, biopsy showing organizing pneumonia pattern, dramatic response to steroids

subject: Infective endocarditis
dx: positive blood cultures, echocardiographic vegetations, fever pattern

subject: Reactive arthritis
dx: sterile synovial fluid, recent GI/GU infection history, HLA-B27 association

subject: Amyloidosis (AL or ATTR)
dx: biopsy showing amyloid deposits with apple-green birefringence on Congo red stain

subject: Lung adenocarcinoma with post-obstructive pneumonia
dx: persistent infiltrate in same location on repeat imaging, bronchoscopy revealing endobronchial mass

subject: Non-convulsive status epilepticus
dx: EEG showing ongoing seizure activity; often subtle motor signs (eyelid twitching, gaze deviation)

subject: Rheumatoid arthritis (acute flare)
dx: symmetric polyarticular involvement, positive RF/anti-CCP, sterile synovial fluid

subject: Eosinophilic pneumonia
dx: peripheral/BAL eosinophilia, lack of antibiotic response, characteristic peripheral infiltrates on CT

subject: Plateau iris syndrome
dx: persistent angle closure despite patent peripheral iridotomy; flat iris on gonioscopy/UBM shows anteriorly positioned ciliary processes

subject: Dementia with Lewy bodies
dx: fluctuating cognition and visual hallucinations predate acute illness; core features (parkinsonism, REM sleep behavior disorder) on history; DAT scan if needed

subject: posterior circulation stroke (cerebellar/brainstem infarct)
dx: HINTS exam (skew deviation, direction-changing/vertical nystagmus, negative head impulse), MRI-DWI, vascular risk factors

subject: Lens-induced (phacomorphic) glaucoma
dx: intumescent cataractous lens causing pupillary block, visible on slit lamp; shallow AC with mature/hypermature cataract

subject: Depression (pseudodelirium/hypoactive presentation)
dx: normal attention on formal testing, mood symptoms, collateral history of prior depression, lack of true inattention on CAM

subject: Contaminated urine specimen / poor collection technique
dx: repeat clean-catch or straight cath sample shows different/no growth; mixed flora on culture

subject: vertebral artery dissection
dx: neck pain/trauma history, CT/MR angiography showing dissection flap or luminal narrowing

subject: Central nervous system infection (e.g., meningoencephalitis)
dx: fever, meningismus, CSF pleocytosis/culture, neuroimaging

subject: Early/incipient urinary tract infection (pre-symptomatic UTI)
dx: clinical follow-up shows evolution to symptomatic UTI with pyuria and systemic signs

subject: Malignant glaucoma (aqueous misdirection)
dx: shallow/flat AC and elevated IOP post-surgery or post-iridotomy despite patent iridotomy; UBM shows anterior rotation of ciliary body

subject: vestibular migraine
dx: history of migraine headaches, photophobia/phonophobia, normal neuro exam, response to migraine prophylaxis

subject: Vaginal/perineal colonization or contamination
dx: epithelial cells on urinalysis, discrepant culture on repeat sampling

subject: Uveitis with pupillary block/iris bombe
dx: anterior chamber cells/flare, posterior synechiae, iris bombe configuration on exam

subject: cardiac arrhythmia/syncope
dx: presyncope/palpitations, orthostatic vitals, ECG/Holter monitoring findings

subject: Leptospirosis
dx: IgM leptospira serology, exposure to contaminated water, conjunctival suffusion, renal/hepatic dysfunction pattern

subject: Chronic indwelling catheter biofilm colonization
dx: persistent bacteriuria despite antibiotics, resolves only with catheter change/removal

subject: Rickettsial infection (scrub typhus/murine typhus)
dx: eschar, Weil-Felix or IgM ELISA positive, rapid defervescence with doxycycline

subject: Malaria
dx: peripheral blood smear/rapid antigen test for Plasmodium

subject: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (secondary HLH)
dx: markedly elevated ferritin, triglycerides, low fibrinogen, hemophagocytosis on marrow; can coexist with VL as trigger

subject: Chikungunya
dx: prominent polyarthralgia disproportionate to fever, chikungunya IgM/PCR

subject: Guillain-Barré syndrome
dx: Ascending flaccid paralysis with albuminocytologic dissociation on CSF, no hydrophobia/autonomic storm typical of rabies encephalitis

subject: Malaria
dx: peripheral smear/rapid antigen test positive, cyclical fever pattern

subject: Lymphoma (especially T-cell/NK lymphoma or splenic lymphoma)
dx: lymph node/spleen biopsy showing malignant infiltrate, no amastigotes, LDH pattern, imaging with bulky nodes

subject: Enteric fever (typhoid)
dx: blood culture positive for Salmonella typhi, relative bradycardia, stepwise fever pattern

subject: Leptospirosis
dx: conjunctival suffusion, myalgia, deranged renal/liver function, serology/PCR positive

subject: Chronic myeloid/myelofibrotic disorders (e.g., CML, myelofibrosis)
dx: peripheral smear leukoerythroblastic picture, BCR-ABL testing, marrow fibrosis/megakaryocyte atypia, absence of amastigotes

subject: Rabies vaccine-induced neuroparalytic reaction (Semple-type / old nerve tissue vaccine reaction)
dx: History of nerve-tissue vaccine use, temporal correlation with vaccine dose, GBS-like pattern rather than furious/paralytic rabies clinical criteria

subject: Amoebic liver abscess
dx: right upper quadrant tenderness, ultrasound showing hepatic abscess, serology positive

subject: Tetanus
dx: Trismus and rigidity without hydrophobia or hallucinations; clear wound history, normal sensorium initially

subject: Compartment syndrome (mechanical, e.g., from tight bandaging or IM injection)
dx: Compartment pressure measurement; disproportionate pain/pallor without systemic coagulopathy markers seen in true envenomation

subject: HIV/AIDS with immune reconstitution or co-infection
dx: HIV serology; VL often atypical, relapsing, or refractory in HIV-positive patients due to underlying immunosuppression

subject: Pre-existing type 2 diabetes mellitus (undiagnosed prior to pregnancy)
dx: Fasting glucose markedly elevated in first trimester, HbA1c ≥6.5% at booking, family history of diabetes

subject: Sepsis/necrotizing soft tissue infection
dx: Blood cultures, rapidly progressive crepitus/necrosis, lack of fang marks, no coagulopathy or neurotoxicity pattern

subject: Serum sickness / immune complex reaction to rabies immunoglobulin
dx: Fever, rash, arthralgia 1-2 weeks after RIG administration; resolves without antiviral therapy

subject: Leptospirosis
dx: Leptospira serology/PCR, conjunctival suffusion, myalgia pattern; eschar absent

subject: Spider bite or other arthropod envenomation
dx: History/geography, absence of characteristic fang marks, different toxin syndrome (e.g., latrodectism causing cramping without coagulopathy)

subject: Maturity-onset diabetes of the young (MODY)
dx: Strong multigenerational family history, young lean patient, mild stable fasting hyperglycemia, genetic testing (e.g., GCK mutation)

subject: Murine typhus
dx: Rickettsia typhi serology; no eschar, urban rat-flea exposure

subject: Anaphylaxis (unrelated allergen) with contact dermatitis
dx: Urticaria/bronchospasm pattern, tryptase level, no local tissue necrosis or coagulopathy

subject: Sarcoidosis
dx: Non-caseating granulomas without acid-fast bacilli; skin biopsy negative for M. leprae by Fite stain and PCR

subject: Latent autoimmune diabetes / Type 1 diabetes evolving in pregnancy
dx: GAD/islet cell antibodies positive, low BMI, rapid progression to insulin requirement, ketosis tendency

subject: Cutaneous tuberculosis / lupus vulgaris
dx: AFB stain, culture, and PCR distinguish M. tuberculosis from M. leprae; different granuloma pattern and nerve involvement absent

subject: Dengue fever
dx: NS1 antigen/dengue serology, thrombocytopenia pattern without eschar

subject: Infective endocarditis
dx: Blood cultures, echocardiogram vegetations, Duke criteria

subject: Steroid-induced hyperglycemia (e.g., antenatal corticosteroids for fetal lung maturity)
dx: Temporal correlation with steroid administration, transient hyperglycemia resolving after steroid course

subject: Enteric fever (Salmonella typhi)
dx: blood culture positive for Salmonella typhi, relative bradycardia, absence of eschar

subject: Cutaneous lymphoma (mycosis fungoides)
dx: Skin biopsy showing atypical lymphocytes/Pautrier microabscesses vs granulomas with bacilli; no peripheral nerve thickening

subject: Reactive/post-infectious arthritis (non-rheumatic)
dx: Asymmetric non-migratory joint pattern, negative ASOT/anti-DNase B, lack of Jones criteria fulfillment

subject: Vitiligo / other hypopigmenting dermatoses
dx: Preserved sensation and normal nerve exam; absence of AFB on slit-skin smear

subject: Celiac disease
dx: Anti-tTG IgA positive, duodenal biopsy villous atrophy

subject: Thalassemia trait/disease
dx: microcytosis disproportionate to Hb, normal/high ferritin, hemoglobin electrophoresis, family/ethnic history

subject: Systemic lupus erythematosus / other autoimmune connective tissue disease
dx: ANA, dsDNA, other systemic features, non-migratory arthritis

subject: Active pulmonary or extrapulmonary tuberculosis
dx: Sputum/GeneXpert, culture, chest imaging showing active disease before starting preventive therapy

subject: Cow's milk protein allergy / cystic fibrosis (malabsorption)
dx: Improvement on elimination diet; sweat chloride test for CF

subject: Vitamin B12 deficiency
dx: macrocytosis, low B12 level, hypersegmented neutrophils

subject: Intussusception
dx: Bloody 'redcurrant jelly' stool, abdominal mass, ultrasound target sign

subject: Congenital or degenerative valvular heart disease
dx: Echocardiographic valve morphology inconsistent with rheumatic pattern, absent history of true ARF episodes

subject: HELLP syndrome / preeclampsia-related hemolysis
dx: schistocytes, elevated LFTs, low platelets, hypertension

subject: Hirschsprung-associated enterocolitis
dx: History of chronic constipation/delayed meconium, rectal biopsy showing aganglionosis

subject: Autoimmune hemolytic anemia
dx: positive direct Coombs test, elevated reticulocytes, indirect hyperbilirubinemia
